title: Write and approve design versions
responsibility: Read verified design images, append a design version, or approve the exact current design content.

inputs.name: planDesign.git
inputs.description: A repository handle used to resolve the unit, revisions, plan state, cleanup, image sources, and the design commit. It is required for repository operations performed by planDesign.

inputs.name: planDesign.input
inputs.description: Identifies the target unit and design prompt; optional generator metadata, notes, contract, base revision, revision source, and expected latest version affect the stored version or validation. Visual plans require images, function plans reject images, and image-free nonvisual plans require notes.

contract.responsibility: Read verified design images, append a design version, or approve the exact current design content.

inputs.name: approve.git
inputs.description: A repository handle used to resolve the unit, current design, image files, cleanup, and approval commit. It is required for repository operations performed by approve.

inputs.name: approve.input
inputs.description: Binds an approval to a unit and version with reviewer, contract hash, and image list, plus optional notes hash and option. Only the latest design can be approved, and its supplied binding must match the current design content.

inputs.name: readImage.git
inputs.description: A repository handle used to resolve revisions and plan metadata and read the image blob. It is required for repository operations performed by readImage.

inputs.name: readImage.input
inputs.description: Identifies the unit, version, and image file; optional revision and option are forwarded to revision lookup and image ownership checks. A supplied nonempty SHA-256 is compared with stored metadata, and the blob hash, dimensions, and byte length are always verified.

inputs.name: readImages.git
inputs.description: Git reader that pins every image read to the same source revision.

inputs.name: readImages.input
inputs.description: Entity, version, optional option and revision, and ordered screenshot hashes.

outputs.name: readImage
outputs.description: Resolves to the stored image metadata plus unit ID, version, verified PNG bytes as a Uint8Array, design commit, and image holding metadata. It rejects when the image is absent or its hash, dimensions, or byte length do not match.

outputs.name: planDesign
outputs.description: Resolves to commit metadata and the appended design version, including hashed prompt and optional notes files, base revision, images, contract hash, and revision source. Versions are numbered from the existing plan length; visual plans require images, functions reject images, and image-free nonvisual plans require notes.

contract.responsibility: Read verified design images, append a design version, or approve the exact current design content.

outputs.name: approve
outputs.description: Resolves to commit metadata and the saved approval record, marked current and bound to the requested version, reviewer, images, contract hash, and notes hash or null. Only the latest design is eligible, and the binding must match its content and any selected approvable option.

errors.name: PlanningFailure
errors.description: A plain Error from the planning fail helper whose code is a PlanningErrorCode, thrown for invalid design input, stale versions, missing images, changed artifacts, or mismatched approvals. Repository, plan-reading, image-decoding, cleanup, and commit failures can also reject the operation.
